name: Capacity Track
description: A directory of open beds in licensed residential care in Minnesota. Assisted living, memory care, group homes, and waiver settings. Families and case managers search once instead of phoning around. Providers pay for a pro plan. The site says it starts from public licensing records, 8,286 licensed settings, with open beds listed first. Founded November 2025. One person.

mentions.evidence: MRR $2,059 from 41 active subscriptions, updated 11 November 2026. All-time $16,591. The listing says about 50,000 people use it, plans are $49 and $99 a month, and the asking price is $100,000. The founder says he is selling to work on a new health-records product. The prices and the asking price are the listing, not the Stripe total.
mentions.indieAngle: The same open-bed list for one kind of licensed place, built on the public register.

whyItPrints: The case manager currently phones around for a bed. This replaces the calls. Providers pay so they show up.
